ModMetaData.name: Cruesoe's Temp Fixes
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Catch-all mod for small personal tweaks and compatibility fixes. Each fix lives in its own conditionally-loaded folder under "Mods", so it only applies when its target mod is active.
Fixes included: - Combat Extended Guns: files the CE Artillery Howitzer under the Ferny_Weapons designation category added by Better Architect Menu, instead of its default category. - Suppresses the harmless red "Failed to find a node with the given xpath" error that Better Architect Menu's own copy of the above patch throws in large modlists (its own edit still no-ops safely; this mod's copy above still lands the actual change). - Progression: Furniture: adds an inert stub def for GR_ScalyBearRug (Dinosauria-only content from Vanilla Genetics Expanded) so Progression: Furniture's rug-research patch stops throwing "Failed to find a node with the given xpath" when neither Dinosauria nor Biomes: Prehistoric is active. The stub is never buildable, craftable, or sellable.
(New fixes are appended to this list as they're added - see the repo's "Mods" folder for the full set.)
